<script>
tl.fromTo("#cam", { scale: 1 }, { scale: 1.08, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#bg", { y: 0 }, { y: -120, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
tl.fromTo(".sat", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 0.8, duration: 0.6, stagger: 0.05, ease: "power2.out" }, 0);

tl.fromTo("#phone", { y: 260, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#near0", { x: -200 }, { x: 0, duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.out" }, 0.05);
const buzz = at("buzz", 0.45);
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  const t = buzz + i * 0.2;
  tl.fromTo("#card" + i, { y: -40, scale: 0.92, opacity: 0, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" }, { y: 0, scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: "expo.out" }, t);
  tl.fromTo("#phone", { rotation: 0, transformOrigin: "50% 100%" }, { rotation: i % 2 ? -1.6 : 1.6, duration: 0.04, repeat: 3, yoyo: true, ease: "none" }, t);
}

const toFocus = at("focus", 1.7) - 0.25;
tl.to("#strip", { y: -1920, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.inOut" }, toFocus);
tl.to("#far", { y: 640, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.inOut" }, toFocus);
tl.fromTo("#target", { scale: 0.85, svgOrigin: "540 2440" }, { scale: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, toFocus + 0.2);
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  const t = toFocus + 0.5 + i * 0.26;
  tl.fromTo("#ping" + i, { x: i % 2 ? 620 : -620, y: -300 + i * 120, opacity: 1 }, { x: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.22, ease: "power3.in" }, t);
  tl.to("#ping" + i, { opacity: 0, scale: 2.2, svgOrigin: "540 2440", duration: 0.12, ease: "power2.out" }, t + 0.22);
  tl.fromTo("#target", { x: 0 }, { x: i % 2 ? -14 : 14, duration: 0.05, repeat: 1, yoyo: true, ease: "none" }, t + 0.22);
  tl.to("#meter", { scaleX: 1 - (i + 1) * 0.27, svgOrigin: "150 2865", duration: 0.3, ease: "expo.out" }, t + 0.22);
}

const toMorning = at("morning", 3.1) - 0.2;
tl.to("#strip", { y: -3840, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.inOut" }, toMorning);
tl.to("#far", { y: 1280, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.inOut" }, toMorning);
tl.fromTo("#clock", { scale: 0.9, svgOrigin: "540 4400" }, { scale: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out" }, toMorning + 0.2);
tl.fromTo("#minuteHand", { rotation: 0, svgOrigin: "540 4400" }, { rotation: 720, duration: 1.1, ease: "power2.inOut" }, toMorning + 0.35);
tl.fromTo("#hourHand", { rotation: 0, svgOrigin: "540 4400" }, { rotation: 60, duration: 1.1, ease: "power2.inOut" }, toMorning + 0.35);
tl.fromTo("#near2", { x: -160 }, { x: 0, duration: 0.9, ease: "expo.out" }, toMorning + 0.1);
</script>
